Only the Wikipedia described UNIX utilities as specified by [[Single_UNIX_Specification#2008:_POSIX:2008|IEEE Std 1003.1-2008]], which is part of the Single UNIX Specification (SUS) is in this category.
These utilities can be found on UNIX operating systems and most Unix-like operating systems.
